source: Synthetic sample data created for a portfolio demonstration. Not client data.
method: Aggregate spend, leads, attributed orders and attributed revenue for the same sample period.
Calculate ROAS = attributed revenue / spend and lead-to-order rate = orders / leads.
Compare channel efficiency, noting attribution limits before proposing an experiment.
limitations: Synthetic aggregates with simple attribution. ROAS is revenue divided by spend, not profit, incremental lift or a causal measure.
